result:
SL-004 is implemented and committed as `4a3f50d`. `npm test` passes all 27 tests and `npm run typecheck` is clean. I wrote `tests/validation.test.ts` first and ran it against the old code. The title tests and the page tests failed, as they should. Then I implemented until they passed. - **API (`src/tasks.ts`, `src/app.ts`):** `POST /api/tasks` now returns `400` with `{ "error": { "code": "validation_failed", "message": … } }`, and nothing is stored. The messages are the ones in `contracts/tasks-api.md`: - A title that is empty or whitespace-only gets "A title is required." (AC-1). - A title over 500 characters after trimming gets "The title is too long (maximum 500 characters)." (AC-2). Exactly 500 characters, even with surrounding spaces, is accepted. - **Page (`public/index.html`, `public/app.js`):** There is a new `

`. On a non-OK response the script shows `error.message` in it using `textContent`, and keeps what the owner typed. A successful submit clears the message. - **Scope:** I did not touch the database layer, as the slice says. I also made a title that is missing or not a string return `400` "Title must be a string.", which the contract lists. Without it that case would have crashed with a `500`. It goes slightly beyond the two ACs. Because validation now trims, I removed the `.trim()` from `createTask`. It only receives titles that have already been validated and trimmed. I left `invalid_json` for malformed request bodies out, since the slice doesn't cover it. Such a request still produces an unhandled error. I did not update the slice status in `.sddpp/` or `wbs.md`, and I did not run Stryker.
